assessment.claim: No exact Pentium G630 plus macOS Ventura 13 test result is recorded. Intel's second-generation desktop Pentium datasheet includes the G630 in the G600 series. Current Dortania guidance states that Ventura drops support for pre-Haswell CPUs and its Sandy Bridge desktop guide lists macOS 12 Monterey as the last supported OS for that generation. This is strong project-guidance evidence against treating the G630 as Ventura-supported, but it is not an exact-system test or Apple's certification.
limitations: The Intel datasheet establishes the processor family and model context, not macOS compatibility.
Dortania is reputable community project documentation, not Apple's official compatibility statement.
No independently verified Ventura test for this exact processor and Lenovo system has been found.
Do not turn this component-level evidence into a complete-system verdict.

sources.title: Intel second-generation desktop Core, Pentium, and Celeron processor datasheet
sources.note: Intel lists the Pentium G630 among the desktop Pentium G600-series processors. Document dated June 2013. Accessed 2026-11-15.

sources.title: Dortania OpenCore Install Guide - Hardware Limitations
sources.note: Current guide states macOS 13 and newer require AVX2 and that Ventura drops pre-Haswell CPU support. This is project guidance, not an exact G630 test. Accessed 2026-11-15.

sources.title: Dortania OpenCore Install Guide - Desktop Sandy Bridge
sources.note: The Sandy Bridge desktop page lists macOS 12 Monterey as the last supported OS and points to the Ventura-specific limitations page. Accessed 2026-11-15.
